items.title: Do we really want the Bureau?
items.summary: My office desk is a cluttered mess of books, stacks of folders, co-worker's gifts, and a slew of pens that have run out of ink. And, I like it too. They sit on either side of me, their desks are noticeably neater. Once we zoom out, we can see that the rest of our digital team, which is dispersed throughout an open space, is seated in the middle of the organization, while our print colleagues tend to work in cubicles.
